request: Was war 2025 mein groesster einzelner Lebensmitteleinkauf pro Monat?

plan.title: Groesster Lebensmitteleinkauf je Monat
plan.question: Die groesste einzelne Buchung der Kategorie Groceries je Monat 2025, eine Zeile pro Monat, Spalten month als 'YYYY-MM' und largest_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(MAX(-amount), 2) AS largest_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND category IN ('Supermarket', 'Bakery')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

request: Was kostet ein Einkauf bei Lidl, Netto und Penny im Schnitt, Monat fuer Monat?

plan.title: Schnitt je Einkauf bei den Discountern
plan.question: Durchschnittliche Ausgabe je Buchung bei Lidl, Netto und Penny je Monat 2025, Spalten month, merchant und avg_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS merchant,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
  AND (lower(description) LIKE '%lidl%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%netto%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%penny%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%aldi%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%edeka%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%rewe%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%kaufland%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%norma%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%dm%')
GROUP BY month, merchant
ORDER BY month, merchant
reasoning_plan:
die Anfrage ist deutsch, also ist die Sprache de
drei Maerkte ueber die Monate, also drei Serien
eine Linie je Markt statt sechsunddreissig Balken
die Spalten sind month, merchant und avg_eur
reasoning_code:
the shape is line and these rows carry a series, so one lineY over all of them
the columns are month, merchant and avg_eur, and avg_eur holds the numbers
merchant names the series, so z and color and a legend
months on x, euros on y over every figure in the rows

request: Was kostet uns ein Tag pro Monat, aufgeteilt nach Kategorie?

plan.title: Tagessatz nach Kategorie
plan.question: Ausgaben je Monat und Kategorie 2025, geteilt durch die Tage des Monats, Spalten month, topic und per_day_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       CASE WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%kaufland%' THEN 'Groceries'
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%aral%' THEN 'Transport'
            ELSE 'Sonstiges' END AS topic,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount) / CAST(strftime('%d', date(booked_on, 'start of month', '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER), 2) AS per_day_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
GROUP BY month, topic
ORDER BY month, topic

request: How does my studio and coworking rent pile up over the year?

plan.title: Studio and coworking, added up
plan.question: The running total over the months of 2025 of what was paid to the studio and the coworking space, columns month and cumulative_eur.

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND coalesce(title, counterparty) IN ('Ateliershaus Ottensen GBR', 'Beta Haus')
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM months
ORDER BY month

request: How does what I pay for eating out add up over the year?

plan.title: Dining spending so far this year
plan.question: The running total of spending in the category Dining over the months of the year, columns month and cumulative_eur.

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Dining'
    AND booked_on BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM months
ORDER BY month
